caption.text:
Kedua tersangka kini telah ditahan dan dijerat Pasal 462 KUHPidana terkait bunuh diri dengan ancaman hukuman 4 tahun penjara. Salah satu pelaku, FR, sempat berkonsultasi dengan AI setelah korban melompat dari apartemen.⁣
⁣
Kasat Reskrim Polrestabes Medan AKBP Adrian Risky Lubis saat konferensi pers, dilansir detikSumut, Rabu (15/7/2026) mengatakan pelaku FR mencari tahu soal proses penyelidikan petugas kepolisian. Rincian yang ditanyakan pelaku ke AI, yakni 'Berapa hari kita akan dipanggil ke kantor polisi sebagai saksi dari waktu kejadian?. 'Kalau ada orang bunuh diri, kita di TKP, berapa lama kita dipanggil?'.⁣
⁣
Lalu, 'Kalau satu minggu setelah kejadian, kita tidak dipanggil oleh polisi, apakah kita sudah di posisi aman atau belum?'. 'Gimana cara supaya tenang menghadapi nanti kalau kita dipanggil polisi?'.⁣
⁣
Baca berita selengkapnya hanya di detik.com! ⁣
⁣
Creator: Putri⁣
⁣

caption.text_translation:
Both suspects have now been arrested and charged with Article 462 of the Criminal Code in connection with suicide with the threat of 4 years in prison. One of the perpetrators, FR, was able to consult with AI after the victim jumped from the apartment.

Kasat Reskrim Polrestabes Medan AKBP Adrian Risky Lubis during a press conference, launched in SecikSumut, Wednesday (15/7/2026) said FR perpetrators are finding out about the investigation process of police officers. Details that the perpetrator asked to AI, i.e. 'How many days will we be called to the police station as a witness from the time of the incident?. 'If someone commits suicide, we are at the scene, for how long are we called? '.

Then, 'If a week after the incident, we were not called by the police, would we be in a safe position or not? '. 'How to be calm to face later if we are called by the police? '.

Read full news only at detik.com !

 Creator: Putri  

 #detikcom #asnnias #asnbpn #medan #sumut
